video_title: Toronto Raptors Full Media Availability | Post Game vs Brooklyn Nets | November 27, 2026

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on team's resilience and growth
quotes.excerpt: seeing how guys were exhausted at the end of the game gives me a lot of confidence
quotes.quote: I am really proud of how hard our guys are playing every single night. It is not just connected with the outcome when we win, but we really play very hard every single night and seeing how guys were exhausted at the end of the game, how guys were exhausted in the locker room, gives me a lot of confidence that this group is just going to continue getting better and improving. I really like the maturity of the team on the court and how we were attacking on offensive end, how we were finding solutions against switches, against some hedges, against some blitzes.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic on the Raptors' recent growth: I am really proud of how hard our guys are playing every single night. Seeing how exhausted they were in the locker room gives me confidence that this group is going to continue getting better.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic discusses the team's performance and resilience following the game against the Brooklyn Nets.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on the team's push for a play-in spot
quotes.excerpt: we knew that we needed to try to be above 20 at least, so we can get
quotes.quote: We were trying to fight the margin. We knew that we needed to try to be above 20 at least, so we can get a wild card. Obviously waiting on other teams as well what they do, but just like guys had a lot of grit to to play all the way through and to to find those plus extra four points.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic on the team's late game push: We knew that we needed to try to be above 20 at least so we can get a wild card. The guys had a lot of grit to play all the way through and find those plus extra four points.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic explains the team's tactical approach to managing point differentials during the game.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on Immanuel Quickley and Scottie Barnes' offensive chemistry
quotes.excerpt: our two main offensive engines at this point are Immanuel Quickley and Scottie Barnes
quotes.quote: Our two main offensive engines at this point are Immanuel Quickley and Scottie Barnes and we are really trying to develop package offensively what those guys can accomplish. I thought that Immanuel Quickley was to the point, the way how he was finding solutions, the way he was touching the paint, the way he was finding assists. I thought that force that Scottie Barnes played with and attacking downhill was really good.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic on the Raptors' offensive identity: Our two main offensive engines at this point are Immanuel Quickley and Scottie Barnes and we are really trying to develop a package offensively what those guys can accomplish.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic discusses the offensive chemistry and development of Immanuel Quickley and Scottie Barnes.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on developing chemistry between Immanuel Quickley and Scottie Barnes
quotes.excerpt: they spend quite a bit of time talking basketball and trying to learn each other
quotes.quote: They spend quite a bit of time talking basketball and trying to learn each other and we watch a lot of film and we are trying to put them in situations that they can work out to create those habits. Doesn't matter what defense is doing for them, still to be effective in in those pick and rolls or DHO actions and I think they are complementing each other really well right now.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic on the chemistry between Quickley and Barnes: They spend quite a bit of time talking basketball and trying to learn each other and we watch a lot of film and we are trying to put them in situations that they can work out.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on injury updates for Jakob Poeltl and Immanuel Quickley
quotes.excerpt: Jakob Poeltl he got the Charlie Horse when he was going over screen he got hit
quotes.quote: Jakob Poeltl he got the Charlie Horse when he was going over screen he got hit in his quad, quad contusion. We will see how he feels in the morning. Immanuel Quickley he was able to finish the game, he had a little bit of sore neck but he was able to finish the game. We will see tomorrow how they feel and where they are.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic provides injury updates: Jakob Poeltl has a quad contusion after getting hit in a screen. Immanuel Quickley finished the game with a sore neck. We will see how they feel tomorrow.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic provides injury updates on Jakob Poeltl and Immanuel Quickley following the game.

quotes.speaker: Immanuel Quickley
quotes.summary_phrase: Immanuel Quickley and Darko Rajakovic on their pick-and-roll chemistry
quotes.excerpt: he just an elite player, it is really easy to play with great players

text_blocks.speaker: Immanuel Quickley
text_blocks.text: Yesterday we spent like probably like 15 minutes just talking through different pick and roll situations with defenders and teams are doing. I try to talk to him throughout the game, but honestly, he is just an elite player. It is really easy to play with great players. I say it all the time. He makes the game really easy for me.

quotes.social_post: Immanuel Quickley on playing with Scottie Barnes: He is just an elite player. It is really easy to play with great players. I say it all the time. He makes the game really easy for me.

structured.context: Immanuel Quickley discusses his pick-and-roll chemistry and communication with Scottie Barnes.

quotes.speaker: Immanuel Quickley
quotes.summary_phrase: Immanuel Quickley on his growing chemistry with Scottie Barnes
quotes.excerpt: I feel like he can just be honest with me, I can be honest with him
quotes.quote: I feel like he can just be honest with me, I can be honest with him either way. If he needs me to do something, if he needs me to be better, if he needs me to pick it up, he gets on me a lot and I appreciate that. So just the honesty, the honest communication, his leadership, what he is willing to do night in night out, I think it makes our team really elite.
quotes.social_post: Immanuel Quickley on the accountability with Scottie Barnes: I feel like he can just be honest with me, I can be honest with him. If he needs me to be better, if he needs me to pick it up, he gets on me a lot and I appreciate that.

quotes.speaker: Immanuel Quickley
quotes.summary_phrase: Immanuel Quickley on the importance of winning at home
quotes.excerpt: the mindset really from soon as I stepped in the arena was just to come in
quotes.quote: It is big. I think it is even bigger that we got the win with it. I know we had been struggling at home, so just the mindset really from soon as I stepped in the arena was just to come in and effect winning whatever it might be, defense, taking care of the ball, getting us in some actions that lead to to good offense, and then defensively trying to get some steals, active hands and stuff like that. So just trying to get a win.
quotes.social_post: Immanuel Quickley on the home win: I know we had been struggling at home, so just the mindset really from soon as I stepped in the arena was just to come in and effect winning whatever it might be.

structured.context: Immanuel Quickley reflects on the importance of securing a win at home after a period of struggling.

quotes.social_post: Immanuel Quickley on Jakob Poeltl: He can do so many things, shoot the ball, athletic, can get to the rim, dunk on people. It is just another one of his strengths that he is able to affect the game with.

quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Barnes on his pick-and-roll chemistry with Scottie Barnes

quotes.excerpt: him just being able to use that screen and going downhill right off of it
quotes.quote: Him just being able to use that screen and going downhill right off of it, I think that just makes it so much of a threat.
